# Test fixtures

* `Alvaro_Uribe_0028.jpg`, `Alvaro_Uribe_0029.jpg` (same person), `Aaron_Tippin_0001.jpg`, `Jose_Luis_Rodriguez_Zapatero_0001.jpg`:
  face images from the public *Labeled Faces in the Wild* dataset, taken from OpenCV's own SFace unit-test data
  (opencv/opencv_extra `testdata/cv/dnn_face/recognition`). Used only by automated tests.
* All resumes, marksheets and experience letters used in tests are generated synthetically inside `test_phase3.py`.
